notes.title: January 6 update
notes.content:
[olist]

     Adjusted the position of the teleporter prompt text

     Objects obstructing the crystal are now displayed semi-transparently

     Removed the boar nest from the first level and reduced the number of boars

     Trees are no longer destructible

     Added a knockback effect when enemies die

     Enhanced the sound effects and blood splatter when enemies are attacked

[/olist]

notes.title: Beginner's guide is added to the game
notes.content:
Updated Content：



     Added beginner's guide and feature tutorials.

     Adjusted the layout of the star map to create a smoother difficulty curve.

     Fixed the issue where the main character kept running while the game was paused.

     Adjusted the energy consumption required for permanent upgrades.

     Modified the logic for spawning enemies in the nest.
